Saol looked upon the world, there was no laughter, no joy. She walked through the wild lands, and flew upon the winds. Wherever she went, there was silence. The Humpties would never comfort her, never laugh or sing. They would not know pain or joy, and they would never seek enrichment or knowledge. She heard nothing but the incessant murmuring of the wind. It was time to fill this world with interesting races.

Saol looked at the wind, and it's incessant mocking. "I will create a race to defy you" she said. "I will call them Murmurs, and they will fill this land with life, and end this silent torment".

Saol took the heart of a Hunter, and she breathed life into it, moulding it into a new form. She created the [Murmurs](http://i.imgur.com/SEU3u3a.jpg), a race of small sentient beings. Murmurs grow to about three feet tall, and have amazing eyesight. They can see across all light spectrums, and into the void itself, with practise and meditation. This powerful sight will even grant some of them premonitions, and the ability to see a short distance into the future. They have soft exoskeletons, and are fast and flexible. Murmurs have soft suction pads on their feet, perfect for walking up crystal surfaces. They also have the ability to blend into their surroundings, like a chameleon. Murmurs love maths and music, and are quite the little engineers. They love tinkering. They worship Andromeda, the great eye of the void.

Andromeda was carefully tending to the barrier when a chorus of voices calling her name came to her attention. It was almost as if they didn't understand what she was at all.

Andromeda supposed that the mortals, and their creators, could not be blamed. After all, her influence on Solus had been minor. Still, while these creatures were so entranced, at least she could put them to some use.

A mild touch here and there, and the Murmurs could become very useful. She had them take inspiration from the peace and quiet, making subdued, gentle music. Furthermore, while listening to a Murmur's song, the nearby world would fall silent, as the Null Space deafened all other sound except those made by other Murmurs, directly or indirectly.

Lastly, she would leave a small gift, a violin, carefully crafted, schematics for how to make more of them, and a small engraved message.

From one Maker of Music to another, you are nothing less than beautiful.

To honour their God, Murmurs believe that Silence is beautiful. So they only make noise, if it is to produce beauty. Even their speech will take on a soft lilting tone. In time they will develop the ability to communicate through colour. They will change their skin colour to communicate, developing their own language of flashing colour.

The demigod Saol creates the murmurs, 3' tall creatures each with a singular massive eye. They have incredible visual prowess that occasionally lets them glance into the future, an incredible love for maths and music, and the ability to blend into their surroundings like a cuttlefish. Due to attention from Adromeda, they endeavour to make noise when they sing beautiful arias.
